packed_image_comparison: Blender image rows reversed compared with GeoTIFF; source height = packed value + constant offset
pixel_mapping: col = (local x + 6000)/5; source row = 3199 - (local y + 9000)/5; samples rounded to nearest pixel center
limitations: Samples cover 11 vertices per grid; not a full evaluated-vertex comparison.
Local grid is a polar stereographic plane and must be transformed to Moon-fixed or local tangent coordinates before viewer placement.
Dataset includes interpolated elevations; see NASA product provenance.
